subject.title: Subagent lifecycle observability + async supervision controls

question: Which core contract should own durable subagent lifecycle receipts and audited cancel/steer/resume supervision: extend the task/audit ledger, add a dedicated subagent lifecycle ledger, or defer to the broader observability/audit design?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but API shape, persistence owner, retention, authorization, redaction, and audit semantics are product/security decisions with multiple plausible owners.

options.title: Extend shared task/audit ledger first
options.body: Make a single durable redacted event and supervision-receipt contract, then project subagent and task timeline views from it.

options.title: Create dedicated subagent ledger
options.body: Add subagent-specific lifecycle storage and RPCs now, accepting a narrower contract that may need later audit unification.

options.title: Defer durable receipts
options.body: Keep current summaries and internal controls until the broader observability/audit work chooses the canonical event model.

recommendation.title: Extend shared task/audit ledger first
recommendation.body: Make a single durable redacted event and supervision-receipt contract, then project subagent and task timeline views from it.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has recent adjacent subagent/task reconciliation history and is the best available owner for the product/security boundary choice.
